# Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Tsung-Yi Lin, Priya Goyal, Ross Girshick, Kaiming He, Piotr Dollár  
**Year:** 2017  
**Journal:** ICCV  
**DOI:** [10.1109/TPAMI.2018.2858826](https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2018.2858826)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1708.02002](https://arxiv.org/abs/1708.02002)

**Keywords:** focal loss, retinanet, object detection

## Abstract

We propose a focal loss that addresses the class imbalance problem during training of dense object detectors.
